note: Conformance vectors: values-only screening verdicts, exact threshold edges (equality passes on every pinned row, one minor unit over fails), per-profile purification with named residuals, and the carve-out/denominator-switch behaviour. Expectations are hand-derived in each independent_oracle and were asserted against compute() at authoring time. Refusal-path vectors live in the sibling .reachability.json. golden_hash values are pinned by golden-parity.test.mjs --update.

vectors.name: msci-retention-pass-nifty-fail
vectors.note: Same company values under two authorities, never merged: the long-form retention screen passes at 28% debt while the 25%-of-total-assets screen fails. Purification splits per profile.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: debt 28000000/100000000 = 28% <= 33.33% (fail iff > threshold, equality passes) so all three long-form ratios pass; purification floor(10000000*3000000/100000000) = 300000 exactly. The 25% screen: 28000000*10000 = 280000000000 > 2500*100000000 = 250000000000 so the debt row fails; interest income 2000000*10000 + 750*0 = 20000000000 <= 300*100000000 = 30000000000 passes; receivables+cash 10000000 <= 9000*100000000/10000 = 90000000 passes; overall false.

vectors.name: msci-entry-buffer-fails-at-31pct
vectors.note: 31% debt clears the 33.33% retention threshold but not the lower 30% entry set, so a non-constituent fails and the entry flag fires.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: 31000000*10000 = 310000000000 > 3000*100000000 = 300000000000 so the debt row fails under the entry set; cash and receivables rows pass (5% and 10% against 30%); overall false.

vectors.name: msci-retention-passes-at-31pct
vectors.note: The identical 31% debt clears the 33.33% retention set for a current constituent; no entry flag.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: 31000000*10000 = 310000000000 <= 3333*100000000 = 333300000000 so the debt row passes; overall true with no flags.

vectors.name: ftse-denominator-switches-to-total-assets
vectors.note: Average daily cap 50000000 falls below total assets 200000000, so the asset value replaces the average as the debt and cash denominator: 10% debt passes here although it would fail (40%) against the average.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: mean(50000000,50000000) = 50000000 < 200000000 so total_assets is used. Debt 20000000*10000 = 200000000000 <= 3300*200000000 = 660000000000 passes (against the average it would fail: 200000000000 > 3300*50000000 = 165000000000). Business activity 5000000 <= 500*300000000/10000 = 15000000 passes. Non-permissible income (4000000+5000000) = 9000000*10000 = 90000000000 > 500*100000000 = 50000000000 fails, so overall false. Dividend purification is not pinned under this profile: purification null plus flag.

vectors.name: purification-split-all-four
vectors.note: All four pinned authorities in one call over identical company values: four independent verdict groups with per-profile thresholds, denominators and purification rules; the daily-average profile pins no purification rule and says so.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: debt 3000000 is 3% of total assets 100000000 and 30% of the average-cap mean 10000000, passing every family (3333 bp, 3333 bp, 3300 bp, 2500 bp); average-cap cash 1000000 = 10% <= 33.33% and receivables+cash 4000000 = 40% <= 49%; the daily-average mean 10000000 < total assets so total assets is the debt/cash denominator; activity 1000000 <= 15000000 passes; non-permissible income 3000000 <= 50000000 passes; the 25% screen: 30000000 <= 250000000 passes; imputed 2000000*10000 <= 300*100000000 passes; receivables+cash 4000000 <= 90000000 passes. Purification: long-form and average-cap floor(10000000*3000000/100000000) = 300000 each; income-ratio floor(10000000*2000000/100000000) = 200000; daily-average null plus flag.

vectors.name: msci-retention-eq-threshold-passes
vectors.note: Debt exactly at 33.33% of total assets passes: every pinned exclusion is expressed as exceeding the threshold, so equality is compliant.

vectors.name: msci-retention-over-threshold-fails
vectors.note: One minor unit above the threshold flips the debt row and the overall verdict.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: 33340000*10000 = 333400000000 > 3333*100000000 = 333300000000, debt row fails; cash and receivables rows still pass; overall false.

vectors.name: msci-entry-eq-threshold-passes
vectors.note: A new entrant at exactly 30% passes the entry set.

vectors.name: msci-entry-over-threshold-fails
vectors.note: One minor unit above the 30% entry threshold fails the new entrant.

vectors.name: msci-m-series-4900-eq-passes
vectors.note: Receivables plus cash at exactly 49% of the 36-month average month-end cap passes the widened threshold; equality semantics again.

vectors.name: msci-m-series-4900-over-fails
vectors.note: One minor unit above 49% of the average cap fails the average-cap profile.

vectors.name: ftse-33pct-and-activity-equality-pass
vectors.note: Conventional debt at exactly 33% of the 24-month average daily cap and business activity at exactly 5% of revenue both pass; the average equals but does not fall below total assets so no denominator switch.

vectors.name: ftse-33pct-over-fails
vectors.note: One minor unit above 33% of the average daily cap fails the debt row.

vectors.name: nifty-all-rows-equality-pass
vectors.note: All three conservative-screen rows at exactly their thresholds (25% debt, 3% imputed interest income, 90% receivables plus cash and bank) pass together.

vectors.name: nifty-all-rows-over-fail
vectors.note: One minor unit over on each of the three rows flips each row and the overall verdict.

vectors.name: purification-remainder-nonzero
vectors.note: A dividend of 9999999 with a 3% prohibited share purifies floor(9999999*3000000/100000000) = 299999 and names the residual 97000000 such that purified + residual/factor_denominator reconstructs the exact share (0.97 of the dividend unpurified).

vectors.name: purification-zero-dividend-valid
vectors.note: An explicit zero dividend purifies to zero with zero residual; the screening verdicts are unaffected.

vectors.name: purification-absent-null
vectors.note: With no dividend supplied the purification legs are null and no purification flag fires; screening still runs.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: dividend absent (undefined) so purification null on every profile; warnings empty.

vectors.name: purification-inconsistent-income-leg-refuses
vectors.note: Prohibited plus interest income (51000000) exceeds total income (50000000), so the purification leg refuses (purification null, named flag, a null dividend-adjustment row) while the screening verdicts stand.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: 49000000 + 2000000 = 51000000 > 50000000 so no factor exists; the debt/cash/receivables ratios are unaffected and compliant true stands.

vectors.name: msci-m-series-window-last-36-of-40
vectors.note: A 40-element month-end series is averaged over its last 36 elements: mean of 1000004..1000039 = 1000021.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: last 36 elements are 1000004..1000039; sum = 36*(1000004+1000039)/2 = 36000774; mean = 1000021 exactly; debt 1 passes trivially.

vectors.name: ftse-admc-from-monthly-averages
vectors.note: The daily-average profile receiving month-end observations announces it: the mean is still computed over what was supplied, and no denominator switch fires (mean 50000000 >= total assets 40000000).

vectors.name: msci-m-carveout-applies
vectors.note: The country-set carve-out subtracts compliant debt from the total-debt numerator on the average-cap profile as well: numerator 25000000 after subtracting 15000000, flag fired, verdict fails at 250% of the average cap.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: 40000000 - 15000000 = 25000000; 25000000*10000 = 250000000000 > 3333*10000000 = 33330000000 so the debt row fails; cash and receivables rows pass; overall false.

vectors.name: proto-key-inert-accepts
vectors.note: A policy_parameters object carrying a prototype-named own key (as JSON.parse produces for "__proto__") is read through a null-prototype own-property view: the key is never consulted and the input screens normally.

independent_oracle.derivation: Hand math: identical to the retention pass case; the injected key names no declared field and is ignored.
